28:23.text: And when he arrived at the water
he found there a group of men watering
, and besides them he found two women who were keeping back
. He said: "What is the matter with you?" They said: "We cannot water
. And our father is a very old man."

28:24.text: for them, then he turned back to shade, and said: "My Lord! truly, I am in need of whatever good that You bestow on me!"

28:25.text: Then there came to him one of the two women, walking shyly. She said: "Verily, my father calls you that he may reward you for having watered
for us." So when he came to him and narrated the story, he said: "Fear you not. You have escaped from the people who are Zâlimûn

28:26.text: : "O my father! Hire him! Verily, the best of men for you to hire is the strong, the trustworthy."

28:27.text: He said: "I intend to wed one of these two daughters of mine to you, on condition that you serve me for eight years; but if you complete ten years, it will be
from you. But I intend not to place you under a difficulty. If Allâh wills, you will find me one of the righteous."

28:28.text: between me and you: whichever of the two terms I fulfil, there will be no injustice to me, and Allâh is Surety over what we say."
